_comment: Tunable strategy/risk knobs. NOT secret - committed to git on purpose so the monthly auto-retune workflow can propose changes here as a reviewable pull request diff. See README.md for what each field means. Validated by tune.py 2026-09-14 (729-combination grid search against ~5 years of real hourly Alpaca crypto data): 315 of 729 passed the safety filter (drawdown <=32%, win rate >=35% in every window); this combo had the highest average return across the three test windows (~3mo/~1yr/~5yr) among safe candidates. exit_zscore ties across -0.5/0/0.5 for this combo - the 5% take-profit consistently triggers before the z-score-based reversion exit would, so it isn't the binding exit condition here; kept at -0.5 as the more conservative of the tied values.
